title: Tests use a crate that Cargo.toml does not declare (anyhow)
summary: Sandbox tests commonly use `anyhow::Result`. If `anyhow` is not declared, the build fails with E0433 even though near-workspaces is already a dev-dependency.
message: `{crate}` is used in {file}:{line} but not declared in {manifest}.

symptoms.pattern: use of unresolved module or unlinked crate `anyhow`

fix.agent: Add `{crate} = "1"` under [dev-dependencies] in {manifest}, then run `cargo test --no-run`.

evidence.observed: Reproduced 2026-11-13 (macOS 15 arm64, rustc 1.100.0, cargo-near 0.23.0, near-sdk 5.30.1, node 26.12.1): sandbox tests using `anyhow::Result` failed with E0433 until `anyhow` was added to [dev-dependencies].
